annotations.title: MOEX index values (IMOEX, RTSI, sector indices) or the index catalogue

description:
MOEX index values (IMOEX, RTSI, sector indices) or the index catalogue. Index level, change/change_pct vs previous close, open/high/low, month/year change, annual high/low and traded value for up to 5 codes (default IMOEX), or code=list for the catalogue of MOEX stock indices (SNDX board + RTS*). Delayed ~15 minutes. Unknown codes -> 404 (not settled).

GET /moex/index — price $0.003 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

code.description: Index code(s), up to 5 comma-separated (default IMOEX; e.g. RTSI, MOEXBMI, MOEXOG), or `list` for the catalogue of stock indices Default: IMOEX.
